name: logs
description: You can use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to monitor, store, and access your log files from EC2 instances, CloudTrail, and other sources.

subcommands.name: associate-kms-key
subcommands.description: Associates the specified KMS key with either one log group in the account, or with all stored CloudWatch Logs query insights results in the account.

subcommands.name: associate-source-to-s3-table-integration
subcommands.description: Associates a data source with an S3 Table Integration for query access in the 'logs' namespace.

subcommands.name: cancel-export-task
subcommands.description: Cancels the specified export task.

subcommands.name: cancel-import-task
subcommands.description: Cancels an active import task and stops importing data from the CloudTrail Lake Event Data Store.

subcommands.name: create-delivery
subcommands.description: Creates a delivery.

subcommands.name: create-export-task
subcommands.description: Creates an export task so that you can efficiently export data from a log group to an Amazon S3 bucket.

subcommands.name: create-import-task
subcommands.description: Starts an import from a data source to CloudWatch Log and creates a managed log group as the destination for the imported data.

subcommands.name: create-log-anomaly-detector
subcommands.description: Creates an anomaly detector that regularly scans one or more log groups and look for patterns and anomalies in the logs.

subcommands.name: create-log-group
subcommands.description: Creates a log group with the specified name.

subcommands.name: create-log-stream
subcommands.description: Creates a log stream for the specified log group.

subcommands.name: create-lookup-table
subcommands.description: Creates a lookup table by uploading CSV data or from CloudWatch Logs query results.

subcommands.name: create-scheduled-query
subcommands.description: Creates a scheduled query that runs CloudWatch Logs Insights queries at regular intervals.

subcommands.name: delete-account-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes a CloudWatch Logs account policy.

subcommands.name: delete-data-protection-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the data protection policy from the specified log group.

subcommands.name: delete-delivery
subcommands.description: Deletes a delivery.

subcommands.name: delete-delivery-destination
subcommands.description: Deletes a delivery destination.

subcommands.name: delete-delivery-destination-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes a delivery destination policy.

subcommands.name: delete-delivery-source
subcommands.description: Deletes a delivery source.

subcommands.name: delete-destination
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified destination, and eventually disables all the subscription filters that publish to it.

subcommands.name: delete-index-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes a log-group level field index policy that was applied to a single log group.

subcommands.name: delete-integration
subcommands.description: Deletes the integration between CloudWatch Logs and OpenSearch Service.

subcommands.name: delete-log-anomaly-detector
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified CloudWatch Logs anomaly detector.

subcommands.name: delete-log-group
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified log group and permanently deletes all the archived log events associated with the log group.

subcommands.name: delete-log-stream
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified log stream and permanently deletes all the archived log events associated with the log stream.

subcommands.name: delete-lookup-table
subcommands.description: Deletes a lookup table permanently.

subcommands.name: delete-metric-filter
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified metric filter.

subcommands.name: delete-query-definition
subcommands.description: Deletes a saved CloudWatch Logs Insights query definition.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes a resource policy from this account.

subcommands.name: delete-retention-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified retention policy.

subcommands.name: delete-scheduled-query
subcommands.description: Deletes a scheduled query and stops all future executions.

subcommands.name: delete-subscription-filter
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified subscription filter.

subcommands.name: delete-syslog-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a syslog configuration for a log group.

subcommands.name: delete-transformer
subcommands.description: Deletes the log transformer for the specified log group.

subcommands.name: describe-account-policies
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all CloudWatch Logs account policies in the account.

subcommands.name: describe-configuration-templates
subcommands.description: Use this operation to return the valid and default values that are used when creating delivery sources, delivery destinations, and deliveries.

subcommands.name: describe-deliveries
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of the deliveries that have been created in the account.

subcommands.name: describe-delivery-destinations
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of the delivery destinations that have been created in the account.

subcommands.name: describe-delivery-sources
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of the delivery sources that have been created in the account.

subcommands.name: describe-destinations
subcommands.description: Lists all your destinations.

subcommands.name: describe-export-tasks
subcommands.description: Lists the specified export tasks.

subcommands.name: describe-field-indexes
subcommands.description: Returns a list of custom and default field indexes which are discovered in log data.

subcommands.name: describe-import-task-batches
subcommands.description: Gets detailed information about the individual batches within an import task, including their status and any error messages.

subcommands.name: describe-import-tasks
subcommands.description: Lists and describes import tasks, with optional filtering by import status and source ARN.

subcommands.name: describe-index-policies
subcommands.description: Returns the field index policies of the specified log group.

subcommands.name: describe-log-groups
subcommands.description: Returns information about log groups, including data sources that ingest into each log group.

subcommands.name: describe-log-streams
subcommands.description: Lists the log streams for the specified log group.

subcommands.name: describe-lookup-tables
subcommands.description: Retrieves metadata about lookup tables in your account.

subcommands.name: describe-metric-filters
subcommands.description: Lists the specified metric filters.

subcommands.name: describe-queries
subcommands.description: Returns a list of CloudWatch Logs Insights queries that are scheduled, running, or have been run recently in this account.

subcommands.name: describe-query-definitions
subcommands.description: This operation returns a paginated list of your saved CloudWatch Logs Insights query definitions.

subcommands.name: describe-resource-policies
subcommands.description: Lists the resource policies in this account.

subcommands.name: describe-subscription-filters
subcommands.description: Lists the subscription filters for the specified log group.

subcommands.name: disassociate-kms-key
subcommands.description: Disassociates the specified KMS key from the specified log group or from all CloudWatch Logs Insights query results in the account.

subcommands.name: disassociate-source-from-s3-table-integration
subcommands.description: Disassociates a data source from an S3 Table Integration, removing query access and deleting all associated data from the integration.

subcommands.name: filter-log-events
subcommands.description: Lists log events from the specified log group.

subcommands.name: get-data-protection-policy
subcommands.description: Returns information about a log group data protection policy.

subcommands.name: get-delivery
subcommands.description: Returns complete information about one logical delivery.

subcommands.name: get-delivery-destination
subcommands.description: Retrieves complete information about one delivery destination.

subcommands.name: get-delivery-destination-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the delivery destination policy assigned to the delivery destination that you specify.

subcommands.name: get-delivery-source
subcommands.description: Retrieves complete information about one delivery source.

subcommands.name: get-integration
subcommands.description: Returns information about one integration between CloudWatch Logs and OpenSearch Service.

subcommands.name: get-log-anomaly-detector
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the log anomaly detector that you specify.

subcommands.name: get-log-events
subcommands.description: Lists log events from the specified log stream.

subcommands.name: get-log-fields
subcommands.description: Discovers available fields for a specific data source and type.

subcommands.name: get-log-group-fields
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the fields that are included in log events in the specified log group.

subcommands.name: get-log-record
subcommands.description: Retrieves all of the fields and values of a single log event.

subcommands.name: get-lookup-table
subcommands.description: Retrieves the full content of a lookup table, including the CSV data.

subcommands.name: get-query-results
subcommands.description: Returns the results from the specified query.

subcommands.name: get-scheduled-query
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a specific scheduled query, including its configuration, execution status, and metadata.

subcommands.name: get-scheduled-query-history
subcommands.description: Retrieves the execution history of a scheduled query within a specified time range, including query results and destination processing status.

subcommands.name: get-storage-tier-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the storage tier policy for the account.

subcommands.name: get-transformer
subcommands.description: Returns the information about the log transformer associated with this log group.

subcommands.name: list-aggregate-log-group-summaries
subcommands.description: Returns an aggregate summary of all log groups in the Region grouped by specified data source characteristics.

subcommands.name: list-anomalies
subcommands.description: Returns a list of anomalies that log anomaly detectors have found.

subcommands.name: list-integrations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of integrations between CloudWatch Logs and other services in this account.

subcommands.name: list-log-anomaly-detectors
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of the log anomaly detectors in the account.

subcommands.name: list-log-groups
subcommands.description: Returns a list of log groups in the Region in your account.

subcommands.name: list-log-groups-for-query
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the log groups that were analyzed during a single CloudWatch Logs Insights query.

subcommands.name: list-scheduled-queries
subcommands.description: Lists all scheduled queries in your account and region.

subcommands.name: list-sources-for-s3-table-integration
subcommands.description: Returns a list of data source associations for a specified S3 Table Integration, showing which data sources are currently associated for query access.

subcommands.name: list-syslog-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of syslog configurations.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Displays the tags associated with a CloudWatch Logs resource.

subcommands.name: list-tags-log-group
subcommands.description: The ListTagsLogGroup operation is on the path to deprecation.

subcommands.name: put-account-policy
subcommands.description: Creates an account-level data protection policy, subscription filter policy, field index policy, transformer policy, or metric extraction policy that applies to all log groups, a subset of log groups, or a data source name and type combination in the account.

subcommands.name: put-bearer-token-authentication
subcommands.description: Enables or disables bearer token authentication for the specified log group.

subcommands.name: put-data-protection-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a data protection policy for the specified log group.

subcommands.name: put-delivery-destination
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a logical delivery destination.

subcommands.name: put-delivery-destination-policy
subcommands.description: Creates and assigns an IAM policy that grants permissions to CloudWatch Logs to deliver logs cross-account to a specified destination in this account.

subcommands.name: put-delivery-source
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a logical delivery source.

subcommands.name: put-destination
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a destination.

subcommands.name: put-destination-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates an access policy associated with an existing destination.

subcommands.name: put-index-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a field index policy for the specified log group.

subcommands.name: put-integration
subcommands.description: Creates an integration between CloudWatch Logs and another service in this account.

subcommands.name: put-log-events
subcommands.description: Uploads a batch of log events to the specified log stream.

subcommands.name: put-log-group-deletion-protection
subcommands.description: Enables or disables deletion protection for the specified log group.

subcommands.name: put-metric-filter
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a metric filter and associates it with the specified log group.

subcommands.name: put-query-definition
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a query definition for CloudWatch Logs Insights.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a resource policy allowing other Amazon Web Services services to put log events to this account, such as Amazon Route 53.

subcommands.name: put-retention-policy
subcommands.description: Sets the retention of the specified log group.

subcommands.name: put-storage-tier-policy
subcommands.description: Sets the storage tier policy for the account.

subcommands.name: put-subscription-filter
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a subscription filter and associates it with the specified log group.

subcommands.name: put-syslog-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a syslog configuration for a log group.

subcommands.name: put-transformer
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a log transformer for a single log group.

subcommands.name: start-live-tail
subcommands.description: Starts a Live Tail streaming session for one or more log groups.

subcommands.name: start-query
subcommands.description: Starts a query of one or more log groups or data sources using CloudWatch Logs Insights.

subcommands.name: stop-query
subcommands.description: Stops a CloudWatch Logs Insights query that is in progress.

subcommands.name: tag-log-group
subcommands.description: The TagLogGroup operation is on the path to deprecation.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns one or more tags (key-value pairs) to the specified CloudWatch Logs resource.

subcommands.name: test-metric-filter
subcommands.description: Tests the filter pattern of a metric filter against a sample of log event messages.

subcommands.name: test-transformer
subcommands.description: Use this operation to test a log transformer.

subcommands.name: untag-log-group
subcommands.description: The UntagLogGroup operation is on the path to deprecation.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-anomaly
subcommands.description: Use this operation to suppress anomaly detection for a specified anomaly or pattern.

subcommands.name: update-delivery-configuration
subcommands.description: Use this operation to update the configuration of a delivery to change either the S3 path pattern or the format of the delivered logs.

subcommands.name: update-log-anomaly-detector
subcommands.description: Updates an existing log anomaly detector.

subcommands.name: update-lookup-table
subcommands.description: Updates an existing lookup table by replacing all of its content with new CSV data or CloudWatch Logs query results.

subcommands.name: update-scheduled-query
subcommands.description: Updates an existing scheduled query with new configuration.
